audience: B2B operations leaders, digital product owners, IT/SRE teams and technical buyers
brand_voice: Modern, upbeat and professional, with an AI-first perspective on the rise of AI-first businesses. Confident and forward-looking, but concrete and evidence-led: optimism comes from clear explanation and practical examples, not hype words. British English, sentence-case headings.
product_truth_note: PRODUCT_TRUTH.md v1.0 is PROPOSED and unvalidated: use it for positioning and terminology; describe every Panoptes capability as design intent ('designed to', 'aims to'); AI Business Intelligence is product vision only. Live /platform/ pages may be cited as on-site context. No customers, metrics, results or availability claims. Conversion pages: /demo/, /contact/.
model_note: Runs on Sonnet 5.5 via a scheduled cloud session (fresh session per run); see RUNBOOK.md.
schedule: Daily 10:37 Europe/London, fresh cloud session per run
cannibalisation_note: Before writing a watchlisted brief, read the listed live pages. If the brief would substantially duplicate one, either sharpen the angle so it is clearly distinct and link to the existing page, or mark the brief merged with merged_into set to the closest brief and explain in qa_findings, recommending the existing page as canonical.
site_checked: 2026-11-13: panoptes.watch is live; this repo IS the site (Astro 5, Cloudflare Pages, deploys from main). Markdown blog at /blog/ built from content/blog/*.md.
publishing_note: Merging into main deploys to production. Articles are Markdown files content/blog/<slug>.md (schema: src/lib/blog-schema.ts, template: content/blog/_template.md). Adding the file is the whole publishing step: listing, RSS, sitemap and search update automatically.
site_checked: 2026-11-13: panoptes.watch is live; this repo IS the site (Astro 5, Cloudflare Pages, deploys from main). /blog/ is a separate code-first blog (content/blog/*.md); campaign articles still go to /resources/.
publishing_note: Merging into main deploys to production. Articles are Astro pages at src/pages/resources/<slug>.astro using ArticleLayout, registered in src/data/site.ts RESOURCES and in META in src/pages/resources/index.astro.
positioning_note: Panoptes observes the business (revenue, customers, finance, operations, delivery), not infrastructure. Many briefs cite APM vendors (Dynatrace) and OpenTelemetry: cite them accurately as the technical-observability context, but frame the article around business-level observability and keep it vendor-neutral. Never imply Panoptes is an APM/infrastructure monitoring tool or integrates with a named product.
brand_voice_guardrails: An AI-first angle is about how AI-first businesses operate and why business observability matters to them. It must NOT turn Panoptes' AI capabilities into claims: AI Business Intelligence is product vision (PRODUCT_TRUTH.md 6H). No predictions presented as fact, no unsourced adoption statistics, no 'revolutionise/supercharge/unlock' filler (AUTHORING.md rule 7).
categories_note: Use one of these categories per article (blog filters are built from front matter; keep the set small).
